# Scandora

> Scandora is an AI document scanner for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android: scan with your phone camera or a real network scanner, let managed AI pull out the details, and send the result into your own Trello and Google Drive. Built in Germany, GDPR-first, on EU servers, with no ads.

Scandora keeps original scans on your device and in the storage you choose. While you are
signed in, only a low-resolution preview and the extracted text sync to our EU servers.
Managed AI covers extraction, indexing and AI document chat out of a monthly credit
allowance — there is no key to obtain or enter. Free, Pro and Business / DATEV plans exist;
the store listing is the binding source for what a plan costs.

The site is bilingual: every page serves English by default and German at the same URL with
`?lang=de`.

## Product

- [Scandora home](https://scandora.eu/): what the app does, the three-step flow, the plan table and the store links.
- [Paperless document scanning for a small business](https://scandora.eu/paperless-small-business): the question-and-answer page for a small business or home office going paperless.
- [A paperless office solution for home](https://scandora.eu/paperless-home-office): the same question-and-answer shape for a household — phone or the Wi-Fi scanner already in the house, separate profiles for private and work paperwork.
- [Scan invoices and extract the data automatically](https://scandora.eu/invoice-data-extraction): which fields managed AI reads off an invoice, what happens to them, and where the page is processed.
- [A document scanner that exports to Trello](https://scandora.eu/scan-to-trello): what lands on the card, how Trello is connected, and why a free Trello account is enough.
- [GDPR document scanner](https://scandora.eu/gdpr-dokumentenscanner): what makes a scanner GDPR-ready — EU hosting, on-device originals, no third-party trackers, an AVV.
- [Document scanner on EU servers](https://scandora.eu/document-scanner-eu-servers): path by path, where each piece of a scan is processed and which sub-processors are involved.
- [For tax advisors and DATEV](https://scandora.eu/datev-steuerberater): the tax-advisor page; the DATEV export it describes is coming soon and is not in this version yet.

## Comparisons

- [Scandora vs CamScanner](https://scandora.eu/vs-camscanner): sourced comparison — who develops each app, where data is processed, network-scanner support.
- [Scandora vs Fileee](https://scandora.eu/vs-fileee): sourced comparison on the same material facts.

## Help centre

- [Help centre](https://scandora.eu/help/): the topic index.

- [Set up a network scanner (eSCL)](https://scandora.eu/help/escl-setup): connecting a Brother or Epson network scanner over eSCL/AirScan.
- [GoBD scope](https://scandora.eu/help/gobd-scope): which record-keeping features ship today and which do not.
- [DATEV export](https://scandora.eu/help/datev-export): coming soon, not available in this version yet.
